Apple Music Like Lyrics (AMLL)

LyricsExpressiveMotion.java adapts the normal-playback stiffness and damping
policy from packages/core/src/lyric-player/base/spring.ts. Its original source
is retained unchanged at third-party/amll/pos-y-spring.ts in the corresponding
source archive and public repository. Attribution: the AMLL project contributors.

The native time sampler, Canvas geometry, bounded visible-row cascade and
duration emphasis envelope are implemented for this Android application.
AMLL's DOM player, Web Animations, Pixi, React and Vue are not bundled.
Its utils/spring.ts solver carries a separate upstream MIT provenance note;
that file and solver were not copied into this application.

Modified Android source and build instructions:
https://github.com/nmm26301-maker/mygo-music
